sources.detail: All six pre-consolidation simple-independent-runner.mjs files were searched at the parent of commit 19fd3d6. Only r67 set APR_SESSION_PROCESS_MODE=1; none contained externalCrmAuthenticationFailure or read crm-auth/checkpoint.json.

Installed r67 and r117 worker/supervisor bundles contain per-process crmAuthRefreshInFlight guards but no interprocess refresh lock. Any crm_auth_server_rejected event was handled as login_required with shared-secret deletion.

The canonical runner was self-attested in both affected runs with sha256 00fb38a8cca229066b376740a9d5758267275f69c6f040fff79dd419dbd06419. A login at 15:29:24Z was followed by rejection at 15:30:07Z; after login at 15:31:53Z cohort 6452 refreshed at 15:38:51Z and cohort 6453 was rejected at 15:40:07Z.

findings.priorSerializationScope: single dashboard or supervisor process only
remainingCandidates: refresh-token rotation race between independent APR processes

requiredBeforeResume: immediate lot stop on any login_required
